mintAuthority.summary: UKTBL is issuer-minted through Spiko PermissionManagers on five EVM deployments, with two-step Minters on Ethereum, Polygon, Base, Etherlink, and Arbitrum plus UKTBL-specific Chainlink CCIP pools on Ethereum, Polygon, Base, and Arbitrum. Each EVM ADMIN Safe can mint directly, change role membership and limits, and upgrade mint-critical logic. Starknet has a 3-of-5 Argent owner/admin multisig plus three additional direct single-key MINTER accounts; Stellar has a single-visible-signer owner/admin plus three direct single-visible-signer MINTER accounts, with no pending Soroban owner/admin transfer at ledger 63675179. The source code has no aggregate supply cap, so configured EVM daily limits are operational throttles rather than economic issuance bounds.

controls.label: UKTBL token restricted mint/burn
controls.capDescription: mint(address,uint256) has no supply cap; authorization is controlled by the PermissionManager.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25618364, authority() = 0x344278aff344d6fb960705dc18a4912221608472 (PermissionManager), owner() = zero, and getRequirements(UKTBL, mint) = 0x05 ({ADMIN, group 2}). The verified Token source has no supply-cap variable; mint is restricted() by PermissionManager authorization.

controls.label: Spiko PermissionManager authority contract
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25618364, getRequirements(UKTBL, mint) = 0x05 and group 0 can change group membership, requirements, daily limits, and UUPS implementations. The current six group-2 contracts were classified by getToken(): only Minter 0x5ed5a75eeed1934ea060186e35187eaa73331366 and UKTBL CCIP pool 0xb114e0e00622ffe5800004a98c8e01cd2c0c393b have a UKTBL mint path. Four other group-2 pools are excluded because their getToken() values are eurSPKCC, EUTBL, SPKCC, or USTBL, not UKTBL.

controls.label: Spiko two-step Minter with daily limit (Ethereum)
controls.capDescription: dailyLimit(UKTBL) is 500000000000 base units (5,000,000 UKTBL at 5 decimals), but an over-limit initiateMint becomes pending and a group-9 approver can execute it; group 0 can also raise the limit or upgrade the Minter.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25618364, this UUPS proxy is in PermissionManager group 2 and canCall(Minter, UKTBL, mint) is true. dailyLimit(UKTBL)=500000000000, getMintedToday=0, and maxDelay=86400. initiateMint requires {ADMIN, group 10}; approveMint and cancelMint require {ADMIN, group 9}; setDailyLimit and Minter upgrade require ADMIN. The current terminal member sets are recorded in the mint-authority review.

controls.label: Spiko UKTBL CCIP token-pool owner EOA
controls.capDescription: Owner of the identified UKTBL CCIP pools; can change router, remote-pool, and rate-limit configuration, so CCIP rate limits are not an immutable aggregate issuance cap.
controls.evidence: owner() of the UKTBL Ethereum pool is this EOA. The verified BurnWithFromMintTokenPool interface exposes owner-controlled router, remote-pool, and chain-rate-limiter configuration.

controls.label: Spiko PermissionManager ADMIN Safe (Ethereum)
controls.capDescription: ADMIN group 0 satisfies the UKTBL mint requirement directly and can change group membership, Minter limits, and UUPS mint-critical implementations without a delay.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25584970, getGroups() confirms this Safe holds ADMIN group 0; Safe reads returned VERSION() = 1.4.1, the six listed owners, threshold 3, no enabled modules, and a zero guard slot. UKTBL mint requires mask 0x05, while upgradeToAndCall on both the token and PermissionManager requires mask 0x01, so this Safe can authorize minters and replace mint-critical logic without a contract-enforced delay.

controls.label: UKTBL Starknet token owner (Argent Multisig, 3-of-5)
controls.capDescription: Token owner, PermissionManager DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holder, and active MINTER_ROLE holder: can mint without a supply cap, upgrade the token class, replace the PermissionManager, and grant mint roles without a delay.
controls.evidence: At Starknet block 12329657, owner() on UKTBL returned this ArgentMultisig; get_threshold() = 3 and get_signers() = five keys. It is the sole current DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holder and one of four live MINTER_ROLE holders on PermissionManager 0x07c7a6db2763d01aa889702bf5eb7b88a01a9df11da0e3d45c96a140c1f43ba3. The source restricts PermissionManager upgrade() to DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE.

controls.label: UKTBL Stellar Soroban restricted mint/burn
controls.capDescription: Minting requires the shared PermissionManager MINTER role; the single-key token owner can replace the PermissionManager and upgrade the token wasm.
controls.evidence: At Stellar ledger 63588183, contract-instance storage identified UKTBL metadata, PermissionManager CBGHLRSX5D5YMBPNK4ZGMUTJUHFIT7YGXGJURM5LFNZ7B6WNSXLGS26M, and Owner GBYIQXBKEB655EB3WTRITS6RR5GXEP6SQRBLPREZHNFYKT7WBMTMPR3H. A no-op upgrade simulation against current token wasm f48f10d9c7d35fc7783b5e27578bf0e764e3a30ff26a3bd7d8e57758c17a9ea8 succeeded from that owner; the source restricts upgrades and PermissionManager replacement to the owner.

controls.label: Spiko UKTBL Stellar contract owner and PermissionManager admin (single-key account)
controls.evidence: At Stellar ledger 63659619, the shared PermissionManager stored this account as Admin. It can upgrade the PermissionManager and, as token owner, replace the PermissionManager and upgrade the token wasm. Horizon shows one visible ed25519 signer of weight 1 and transaction thresholds 0/0/0; it is not described as a 1-of-1 threshold account.

controls.label: Spiko two-step Minter with daily limit (Polygon)
controls.capDescription: The Minter is group 2 for Polygon UKTBL. ADMIN can change its daily limit and upgrade it; an over-limit initiated mint becomes pending and can later be approved by group 9, so the daily limit is not a hard economic cap.
controls.evidence: The complete Polygon PermissionManager group-2 add/remove history and a live canCall read identify this proxy as a current UKTBL minter. Its implementation is 0x465bc3e57a76905699df6772ee2571058a55f37a; the verified Minter source defines the initiator, approver, daily-limit, and upgrade paths.

review.evidence: Full deployment-to-head GroupAdded/GroupRemoved reconciliation plus live role reads enumerated every EVM UKTBL mint path: group 0 is the recorded 3-of-6 chain-local Safe and group 2 is the chain-local Minter plus the UKTBL CCIP pool on Ethereum, Polygon, Base, and Arbitrum; Etherlink has only its Minter. All non-UKTBL group-2 pools were classified by getToken() and excluded. Minter group-10 initiators and group-9 approvers are explicitly recorded for every EVM chain. EIP-1967 reads at the cited heads resolve all five chain-level Minter proxy paths to their implementations; the recorded group-0 ADMIN Safes authorize their UUPS upgrades. On Starknet, complete RoleGranted/RoleRevoked history and live has_role reads at block 12329657 yield exactly four MINTER_ROLE holders: the 3-of-5 Argent owner/admin multisig and three single-key account contracts. On Stellar at ledger 63659619, enumerable PermissionManager reads yield exactly three MINTER accounts; Horizon shows those accounts and the owner/admin each have one visible ed25519 signer and zero transaction thresholds. EVM Minter daily limits are not hard bounds because group 9 can approve an over-limit pending request and ADMIN can change limits or logic. Public sources do not identify the operating entities or custody arrangements for the terminal EVM signer addresses. The current active Stellar roles are enumerated, and on 2026-07-27 Kimi data review independently decoded the Soroban pending-transfer state via mainnet.sorobanrpc.com getLedgerEntries at ledger 63675179: the token CDT3KU6TQZNOHKNOHNAFFDQZDURVC3MSTL4ML7TUTZGNOPBZCLABP4FR instance storage still lists Owner GBYIQXBKEB655EB3WTRITS6RR5GXEP6SQRBLPREZHNFYKT7WBMTMPR3H with no PendingOwner key, the PermissionManager CBGHLRSX5D5YMBPNK4ZGMUTJUHFIT7YGXGJURM5LFNZ7B6WNSXLGS26M instance storage still lists Admin GBYIQXBKEB655EB3WTRITS6RR5GXEP6SQRBLPREZHNFYKT7WBMTMPR3H with no PendingAdmin key, and the temporary-storage PendingOwner and PendingAdmin contract-data entries are absent on two independent public RPCs. Because the OpenZeppelin stellar-access 0.4.1 role-transfer helper stores pending transfers only in temporary storage, no pending owner or admin transfer exists at the pinned ledger and no future authority transition is staged.
